The '''Gamor Run''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] on which the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Lo Khan]] made the biggest haul of his career. Khan was saved by [[Luwingo]] from a battle with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the run.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Leland Chee]] made it clear that the "Gamor" of this Run and the "[[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]" from which the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] species originates are two different things.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=158725&start=0#5978529|thread=Spelling Discrepancies|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2004-02-25|time=5:53 PM|quote=Gamorr vs. Gamor. Actual difference.}}</ref>
